# Known Python Ladder Failures
# ============================================================
# List fixture failures that are pre-existing upstream Monty issues.
# Format: tier_file:test_name
# Example: tier_07_advanced.json:class_inheritance_basic
#
# The ladder gate script compares actual failures against this list:
# - NEW failure (not in list) → FAIL the gate
# - KNOWN failure (in list) → PASS with notice
# - KNOWN failure starts passing → PASS with notice to remove from list
#
# When adding entries, file an upstream pydantic/monty issue and
# reference it in a comment:
# tier_07_advanced.json:class_inheritance_basic  # pydantic/monty#123
# ============================================================
